nodes.name: Resolve URLs Safely
nodes.notes: Uses Node core DNS/net/http/https/url modules. Redirects are never automatic: every Location target is parsed, DNS-validated, checked against blocked IP ranges, and pinned before the next request.

parameters.content:
## Architecture Phase 6D

Optional URL-resolution enrichment only.

- resolves only the fixed shortener allowlist
- maximum 10 detected URLs, 5 attempted resolutions, 3 redirects
- 4 second timeout per outbound request
- no automatic redirect following
- DNS and all returned IPs are validated before every hop
- the selected validated IP is pinned for the outbound connection
- no page crawling, cookies, credentials, response bodies, or database writes

Self-hosted n8n must allow these Code-node built-ins: `dns,net,http,https,url`.
